title: Aipa calls for stronger food reserves, closer energy cooperation
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian lawmakers are calling for stronger food reserves, expanded support for farmers and fisherfolk, and closer cooperation to protect the region’s energy supplies…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian lawmakers are calling for stronger food reserves, expanded support for farmers and fisherfolk, and closer cooperation to protect the region’s energy supplies from global disruptions.
